content:
The **Mystery Meat Pie** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

A pie containing an assortment of unknown ingredients.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Intestine (2) Spices (1) Spoiled Meat (2) Toxic Water (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Mystery Meat Pie | | Mystery Meat Pie (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the appropriate ingredients after learning the Recipe for it.
